notes.title: First Patch is OUT! Big Changes!
notes.content: [p]Here's what's changed in the first patch:[/p][p]- Quickstart mode by holding 3 or K is available after your first / second playthrough[/p][p]- Library date path will be more forgiving and have a new target indicator, it is STILL the hardest date to hit, but will reward trial and error[/p][p]- Movie date trigger moved down slightly so it's a bit easier to hit[/p][p]- One extra life available in both Movies and Beach bonus areas[/p][p]- Bump mechanic (3 or K) improved[/p][p]- Bugfix - can now purchase discounted items with exact change[/p][p]- New ball launcher input option - 3 or K[/p][p]- New reset game input option - 3 or K[/p][p]- Typos fixed[/p]
